title: Luxury Feel and Sedan Comfort
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe the G70 as delivering a refined luxury-sedan experience with praise for interior quality, smoothness, comfort, and overall premium feel, while many fragments are too brief to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the interior luxury, seat comfort, smooth ride, refined road manners, and strong value as a luxury sedan.

negative.summary: The only negative review is about unacceptable service for a buyer of an expensive car rather than the vehicle's luxury attributes themselves.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention luxury or luxury-sedan expectations but often lack enough context to confirm whether the sentiment is favorable or unfavorable.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are short or incomplete, which limits confident interpretation of sentiment.
The negative example concerns service expectations after purchase rather than the car's luxury comfort or design, so topic coherence is somewhat mixed.
Samples are sentiment-stratified and not representative estimates of all G70 reviews.
